sharedMapEvidence: Not applicable — no protocol. Grouped as one retail line (12 V DC to 120 V AC modified-sine inverters, identical feature list across wattages at Home Depot Canada).
gotchas: The bundled 'remote control' is a wired on/off pendant, not a data link. The LCD shows output watts, input voltage and battery level locally and exports none of it.
Modified sine wave on EN2000. Worth recording for a cabin: it is not a substitute for a pure-sine inverter on sensitive loads.
checked: 2026-07-31. Retail listing only; no manual was opened, so 'no comms' is unverified rather than vendor-doc.
12 V DC input only — this is a vehicle/portable inverter, not a house inverter, and will not appear as a house AC source.
